experiments.active_stability: Completion persistence relative to user active days/weeks, transition returns and burst concentration; not old raw distinct-day/week counts.
experiments.channel_calendar: Exact interval-overlap channel x weekday x 2-hour completed-viewing profiles, population-channel shrinkage and known future compatibility; not rejected global midpoint habits.
experiments.matched_drift: Change of personalized channel/calendar-matched opportunity rates between history and forecast, gated by individual completions; not raw future volume.

features_control: frozen V5 59 columns, same pools and learned preprocessing cutoffs
weights: unchanged V5 normalized LambdaRank user-task groups; no classifier class weighting
selection: Both gains >=0.001 and paired95 lower>0; heavy gain>=0, light and repeat-heavy gains>=-0.003 both; cold lists identical. Else retain V5.
unchanged_target: >=80% uninterrupted original airing duration; distinct-airing frequency Top5; ID ties; all1260, empty=0
